biotools.summary: Free macOS application for TaqMan endpoint SNP genotyping. Calls genotypes from two-channel allelic discrimination data with five independent algorithms (ALCHEMY, BCGA, fitPoly, polar thresholds, robust Student-t mixture) and a configurable consensus, with spectral compensation, QC metrics, Hardy-Weinberg and case/control association statistics, multi-plate cohorts, and publication-ready exports including R and Python reproducibility scripts. Reads RDML and tab-delimited endpoint exports. Runs fully offline

function.note: Calls genotypes from two-channel endpoint allelic discrimination data with five independent algorithms and a configurable consensus, then computes QC, Hardy-Weinberg and case/control association statistics with exportable figures and reports.

biotools.name: SNPlytics
